**Implementation note:** Engle-Granger pairs as published (short leg, out of scope); a long-only spread signal exists.

## Description

Estimate cointegrating relationships and trade deviations of a stationary spread around equilibrium.

## Where it may fit

Pairs with stable long-run relationships and temporary dislocations.

## Vehicles

Market-neutral equities, ETF pairs, futures spreads.

## Required data

Synchronized adjusted prices, rolling cointegration tests, hedge ratio, spread z-score, borrow and transaction costs.

## Caveats

Cointegration can break; use out-of-sample pair selection and monitor parameter drift.
